mapper.select: SELECT d.id,d.capability_key,d.name,d.description,d.status,d.default_version_id,v.version_key AS default_version_key FROM nw_capability_definitions d LEFT JOIN nw_capability_versions v ON v.id=d.default_version_id AND v.definition_id=d.id AND v.tenant_id IS NULL AND v.capability_type=d.capability_type WHERE d.tenant_id IS NULL AND d.capability_type='SKILL' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_workflow_test_sessions wt WHERE wt.capability_definition_id=d.id) ORDER BY d.updated_at DESC,d.id DESC

SELECT d.id AS definition_id,d.name,v.id AS version_id,v.version_key, CASE WHEN d.capability_type='SKILL' THEN (v.descriptor->>'estimated_tokens')::bigint END AS skill_estimated_tokens, d.capability_key,d.description FROM nw_capability_definitions d JOIN nw_capability_versions v ON v.id=d.default_version_id AND v.definition_id=d.id AND v.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.tenant_id AND v.capability_type=d.capability_type WHERE d.capability_type=#{type} AND d.status='PUBLISHED' AND v.status='PUBLISHED'
AND d.tenant_id IS NULL AND (d.tenant_id=#{tenant} OR d.tenant_id IS NULL)
AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_workflow_test_sessions wt WHERE wt.capability_definition_id=d.id) ORDER BY d.updated_at DESC,d.id DESC
